member.summary: An AutoCAD tool call. All of this bridge's AutoCAD calls pass a FIFO gate, so calls the CLI sends together (the next run_commands stage queued behind the current one) reach AutoCAD in order, one at a time; a run_commands that waited behind a run_commands that failed is skipped, so a queued stage never builds on a broken one. Read results of are served from the cache while the drawing revision is unchanged; every other call clears those entries.

member.name: T:AcadCopilot.McpBridge.ResponseCache
member.summary: Cache of deterministic, expensive read results of one bridge (one CLI call of one chat): get_drawing_info, list_layers, list_entities pages, get_entity and recall_knowledge. Every entry carries the stamp it is valid for: the drawing revision (AutoCAD bumps it on every object change, undo and drawing switch) for drawing tools, and the knowledge files' stamp for recall_knowledge. The bridge serves an entry only when the current stamp is the same and the entry is young enough, and clears the drawing entries after every call that may change the drawing.
